title: Sunset Sailing Cruise on San Diego Bay | Champagne Included
includes: 2.5 hour shared or private sail (depending on option chosen)
Polaroid Camera & Film (available for purchase) (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
What makes this experience truly special is the blend of refined European luxury and a relaxed, intimate atmosphere without the feel of a large group tour. You will be sailing aboard a beautifully crafted French yacht designed for luxury cruising. With limited capacity on board there is plenty of space to move freely, unwind on deck and enjoy a more personal unhurried sail across San Diego Bay.

Your captain Dylan is friendly knowledgeable and passionate about sailing the bay. He creates a warm easygoing environment while maintaining professional seamanship and attentive hospitality. Whether you would like to learn about sailing, take the helm, sip a glass of wine or simply relax and enjoy the views. Every sail feels thoughtfully curated and designed to feel less like a tour and more like being welcomed aboard a beautiful yacht for a memorable day on the water.
